channel.title: inhuman.systems — Saket Atreya
channel.description: Writing on intelligence, reinforcement learning, philosophy, and political economy.

item.title: Hindutva and the Production of Hyperreal Hinduism
item.description: We must understand Hindutva as a productive apparatus that generates mythology, and that this mythology is self-propagating not because it corresponds to reality but because it creates feedback loops connecting institutional practice, affective investment, territorial violence, and electoral calculation.

item.title: Solving Pokémon as a POMDP
item.description: A technical deep-dive into building a Gen 9 Random Battle agent that learns from nothing but wins and losses through Bayesian Belief Tracking, Observation Engineering, and Pure RL

item.title: The Wrong Unit of Analysis
item.description: Why Intelligence Requires a Differential Field

item.title: Let Capital Win: The Case for Accelerating through Automation
item.description: AI is capital's completion project. The left has always wanted to abolish wage labor but couldn't figure out how to abolish the necessity that made wage labor necessary.

item.title: The Iran War Did Not Take Place (And Is Killing People)
item.description: Baudrillard, Generative AI, and the Colonial Monopoly on the Real

item.title: Latent Space
item.description: In the latent space, there are no individuals. Only vectors. Directions through an impossibly high-dimensional manifold where meaning itself becomes geometry.
